basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old avid gamer and collector based in Toronto, Canada. I've been a fan of the Tomb Raider series since the late '90s, and I love exploring the history and development of video games. By day, I work as a software developer for a start-up focusing on VR applications, which aligns with my interest in cutting-edge technology. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner, who shares my passion for gaming. I typically browse Reddit during the evenings after work and on weekends. Apart from gaming, I enjoy discussing theological concepts and occasionally dabble in programming scripts for automation.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in software development, specifically in VR technologies. I hold a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My passion for gaming has provided me with a deep understanding of game mechanics and development history, particularly regarding the Tomb Raider franchise.
